segmentation.text: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow:
or riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
may proceed straight through or turn in the direction opposite that indicated by the green turn arrow if:

(1) The person stops before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection where the sign or pavement marking indicates where the stop must be made or, in the absence of any such crosswalk, sign or marking, before entering the intersection;
(2) The person waits for two complete cycles of the lights or lighted arrows of the applicable official traffic-control device and the signal does not change
because of a malfunction or because the signal failed to detect the presence of the motorcycle, moped, trimobile, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter;
(3) No other device at the place prohibits the turn,
and (4) The person yields the right-of-way to pedestrians lawfully within an adjacent crosswalk and to other traffic lawfully using the intersection.

elements.justification: The signal is a dev.traffic_signal, 'several states may be displayed at once': a steady red with a green turn arrow is circular_red displayed together with green_arrow(left) or green_arrow(right). It is the signal governing (dev.governs) the approach carrier of kind st.travel_region the road user occupies (rel.occupies) whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters), or the intersection (st.intersection) itself; read at the entry, the event the words fix it to.
'motorcycle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle ('every motor vehicle equipped with a seat or saddle ...'); 'A person driving' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

'moped' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped. 'trimobile' has no applicable definition; nearest class atom ru.motorcycle, 'motor vehicle on two or three wheels ridden astride, including three-wheeled variants'; a three-wheeler driven from a seat is not denoted, so a gap is recorded.
The admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle and DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, each claimed as its aggregate.

Facing the signal: the signal governs (dev.governs) the carrier the road user occupies (rel.occupies) at the observation before its entry whose entrance end is the intersection (st.lane_enters), or the intersection itself; the heading is not read, as st.lane_enters states.

Proceeding straight through is drv.motion.straight_through_region(x, i); the turn opposite the arrow is drv.motion.right_turn_through_region(x, i) under green_arrow(left) and drv.motion.left_turn_through_region(x, i) under green_arrow(right); each reads the heading change since entry from kin.yaw_rate and the overlap with the intersection, recognized at the exit.

Waiting is staying on the approach without entering the intersection after the halt (drv.motion.stopped, a required stop of DEF-NRS-484A-255 'complete cessation from movement') that begins the wait, on the carrier (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) that enters the intersection (st.lane_enters). The applicable official traffic-control device is the dev.traffic_signal governing (dev.governs) that approach; a complete cycle of its lighted arrows is one display of the green turn arrow (green_arrow(dir)) that begins and ends while the road user waits, counted with the formula's count of rising edges since the wait began against the law's literal 'two'. The signal not changing is the governing signal displaying no circular_green at any observation of the wait.

residues.why: The cause the words name (a malfunction, or a failure to detect the road user) is what a signal's not changing for a waiting road user through two complete cycles consists in; once the obligation reads two complete cycles with no change, the cause adds no further restriction, so the duty is the same whether or not these words are read.

applicability: As NRS_484B_307_9b_o1: x is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-135::motorcycle, DEF-NRS-484A-125::moped, DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle or DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, or carries ru.motorcycle; at the judged observation x leaves an intersection i; at x's entry into i (read through a past operator) a traffic signal s governing x's approach carrier c (dev.governs(s, c), st.lane_enters(c, i)) or i displayed circular_red with green_arrow(dir), dir left or right; and the crossing is a through movement or a turn opposite the arrow (drv.motion.straight_through_region, drv.motion.right_turn_through_region under a left arrow, drv.motion.left_turn_through_region under a right arrow).
obligation: At the entry (read through a past operator from the exit): x's wait on c is the stretch since x last halted on c (the rise of drv.motion.stopped with p.motion_speed_tolerance while x occupies c and not i); during that stretch x did not occupy i, the green_arrow(dir) display of s went out, after having lit within the stretch, at least the literal two times (a count of rising edges of that event since the wait began, Formula.count with ge 2), and s displayed no circular_green at any observation of the stretch. Violated where x entered with fewer complete arrow cycles in its wait or after s had displayed circular_green during it. Where the wait began before the recording, the count is unknown.

narrowings.why: 'A person driving' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
The 'applicable official traffic-control device' is the signal head present and governing the approach; its official status is presumed from its presence.

A complete cycle of the lights or lighted arrows is read as one display of the green turn arrow that lights and goes out within the wait; a cycle of the circular indications without an arrow display is not counted separately.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A motorcycle halts at the stop line of a lane governed by a signal showing circular_red with green_arrow(left); the left arrow lights and goes out once; the motorcycle then enters and goes straight through.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The motorcycle halts, the left arrow lights and goes out twice while the circular red stays on and no circular_green is ever shown, then it enters and goes straight through.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle enters on circular_red with green_arrow(left) and turns left with the arrow.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A moped waits and goes straight through; the source does not observe signal states.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle halts, the signal shows circular_green once during its wait and returns to red with a left arrow; after two further arrow displays the bicycle goes straight through on red.

param_proposals.name: p.left_turn_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: The heading change to the left beyond which a manoeuvre is a turn rather than a lane change or a bend's drift.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide).

param_proposals.name: p.motion_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Speed resolution: the noise floor of a source's speed estimate, below which a road user is read as standing still.
param_proposals.source: Speed-estimate noise of tracked road users.

param_proposals.name: p.reversal_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: The heading change magnitude from which the heading has come round to the opposite direction (a reversal); also the upper bound of a turn.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide).

param_proposals.name: p.straight_through_max_heading_change
param_proposals.convention: Turning-movement classification at a junction: a crossing whose net heading change stays below this bound is a through movement.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide).

param_proposals.name: p.right_turn_min_angle
param_proposals.convention: The heading change to the right beyond which a manoeuvre is a turn rather than a lane change or a bend's drift; the right-hand counterpart of the left-turn bound.
param_proposals.source: Turning-movement classification at junctions (FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide turning-movement counts; the left-turn bound of this reading).

gaps.proposal: `ru.trimobile` | a motor vehicle designed to travel on three wheels in contact with the ground, whether ridden astride or driven from a seat, as the jurisdiction classes it; decides which road users the permission at a steady red with a green turn arrow concerns | local
gaps.nearest: ru.motorcycle: 'motor vehicle on two or three wheels ridden astride, including three-wheeled variants' leaves out a three-wheeler driven from a seat
